metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 2026 · Sacrifice
metas.description: At an elite fundraising gala, celebrities and socialites find themselves in danger when armed activists storm the venue in pursuit of a legendary relic that could unlock supernatural powers.

metas.name: 1932 · The Prince of Arcadia
metas.description: Both the King and his son have been deposed by popular demand. The now Prinz of Arkadia certainly enjoys his new role, which without much changing his lifestyle leaves him free to concentrate on his main interest -women. Including an actress who once wrote a mocking song about him -a song that he likes to sing.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Deewana
metas.description: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2026 · Bouma
metas.description: Bound to an estate shrouded in tragic secrets, a struggling singer journeys to a place she barely remembers, only to find the line between her past and present blurring.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1991 · Europa
metas.description: Just after World War II, an American takes a railway job in Germany, but finds his position politically sensitive with various people trying to use him.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Paachuvum Albhuthavilakkum
metas.description: A middle-class Malayali youth who is settled in Mumbai and revolves around incidents that take place on a journey to Kerala.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · A Child of My Own
metas.description: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · De Gaulle: Résistance
metas.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Reawaken Man: The Red
metas.description: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

metas.name: ★ 9.7 · 2026 · Summer Holidays
metas.description: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · Mookuthi Amman 2
metas.description: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2026 · Yen Ennai Edho Seidhai
metas.description: Broken young man trapped in emotional darkness finds unexpected healing when Madhu's love guides him from self destruction toward hope, purpose, and light.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Disco
metas.description: An ordinary man undergoes a transformation as he enters the dark and dangerous world of the underworld.

metas.name: 2026 · I Play Rocky
metas.description: A failing actor writes the ultimate underdog story and must fight for his chance to play the role of a lifetime - Rocky Balboa.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Drummer Boy
metas.description: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

metas.name: 2026 · A Dog's Perfect Christmas
metas.description: A sage basset hound narrates how his family faces turmoil when Mrs. Goss falls into an induced coma, and a new Corgi pup helps unite the scattered household during their mother's absence.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · A Story of Derry
metas.description: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Minotaur
metas.description: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

metas.name: 2026 · Musk
metas.description: A thorough and unvarnished analysis of Elon Musk, a technology billionaire who serves as the CEO of Tesla, SpaceX, and Twitter.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The History of Concrete
metas.description: A filmmaker applies lessons from a Hallmark movie writing workshop to pitch a documentary about concrete.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Remain Calm
metas.description: The story follows the two gas station clerks whose routine night shift turns into a fight for survival. A government agent warns them about Mr. Frett, a terrifying creature that tracks and hunts people who show any signs of anxiety, stress, or panic. To stay alive, the characters must force themselves into a state of aggressive positivity and calm.
